sources.name: Wikidata and Wikipedia
sources.freeLimit: $0; keyless public API with polite-use limits
sources.termsNote: Use the public API with a named User-Agent, bounded category reads, maxlag and cached records. Wikipedia text stays attributed under CC BY-SA; Wikidata facts are CC0.

sources.name: The Odds API free plan
sources.freeLimit: 500 credits per month; the stored remaining-credit guard stops at zero
sources.termsNote: Use one region and one market. The runtime reads the quota headers and refuses the next call when no free credit remains.

sources.name: Cito UFC API free plan
sources.freeLimit: 500 calls per month, 200 per day and 10 per minute; each run reserves at most two calls
sources.termsNote: The runtime keeps conservative monthly and daily counters and stops before a run that could cross either free limit.

sources.name: Owner-reviewed import
sources.termsNote: Every row needs source references and owner review. The importer rejects malformed rows and writes the canonical bout history once.

sources.name: Pinned UFCStats actor
sources.freeLimit: $0 cash; at most 10 Free-tier results per run inside the $3 MMA Apify share
sources.termsNote: The actor is logged-out and public-data-only, but UFC terms prohibit automated page scraping and ufcstats.com publishes no separate permission reviewed by the desk. Keep disabled unless written permission resolves the conflict.

sources.name: Pinned ESPN MMA actor
sources.freeLimit: $0 cash; 30 game rows per run inside the $3 MMA Apify share
sources.termsNote: The actor reads ESPN public JSON without a login, but the desk found no official API license authorizing commercial automated reuse. Keep disabled pending written permission or a licensed endpoint.

sources.name: Pinned Tapology Oktagon promotion reader
sources.freeLimit: $0 cash; one promotion page per run with a $0.05 actor charge ceiling
sources.termsNote: Restricted to the public Oktagon promotion and event facts, excludes Tapology rankings, login and training use, and follows the site's 2026 Content-Signal use=reference permission. Only short factual fields and source URLs may enter FightAIQ.

input.pageFunction: async function pageFunction({ $, request }) { return { sourceUrl: request.url, title: $('h2').first().text().trim(), text: $('main').text().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 50000) }; }

sources.name: Pinned Sherdog profile actor
sources.termsNote: Sherdog terms bar collating service content elsewhere and restrict automated request volume. FightAIQ would collate profile facts, so this actor remains pinned for auditability but cannot run.

sources.name: UFC and Oktagon public pages
sources.termsNote: No automated reader is enabled. Approve a written terms review before adding either organization host to the intake.
